Name: Seasonal Junimo Plush for Content Patcher
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]
Turns your Junimo Plush into a different color every season!

[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
3. Download and unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.[/center]
